title: CoinRun tokenizer v2 adaptive scale and visual-quality gate
question: What is the smallest CoinRun tokenizer scale that clears held-out global, edge and temporal-change reconstruction gates while retaining the fixed latent interface required by dynamics?
reason: CR-DEMO-0001 was technically runnable but visually unusable. Its 0.17M tokenizer reached only 24.2447 dB held-out EMA clean PSNR and visibly lost small sprites and platform edges, so dynamics scaling must pause until the representation bottleneck is improved.
hypothesis: Scaling the tokenizer backbone while holding the latent interface, data, seed and primary per-arm FLOPs fixed will improve both full-frame and detail-sensitive reconstruction; at least one candidate at or above the local 3.7M label will clear the preregistered quality gate.
falsification: The hypothesis is rejected if no candidate through the conditional 16.6M label clears the full-frame, edge and temporal-change gates, or if a qualifying tokenizer cannot preserve the 16-latent by 16-channel interface needed by dynamics.

data.policy: 65% goal-directed persistent right/right-jump/no-op macros mixed with 35% balanced persistent left/left-jump/no-op/jump/right/right-jump macros

compute.estimated_budget: 3e16 FLOPs for the primary three arms; conditionally +2e16 and +4e16 only when prior scales miss the quality gate
compute.shutdown_policy: A bounded shutdown timer is created before launch; a monitor stops the existing instance after terminal artifacts are synchronized.

evaluation.visual_artifact: one retained reconstruction grid per scale plus a vertically aligned comparison grid

success_criteria.rule: Every primary arm completes its native 1e16 FLOPs allocation from random initialization and produces finite held-out metrics on the identical 512 clips.

A candidate is metric-eligible only if EMA clean PSNR is at least 26.0 dB and improves over the v2 n0.17m arm by at least 1.0 dB clean, 0.75 dB on target-edge pixels and 0.75 dB on temporal-change pixels.
If the primary three arms miss SC-2, train n8.6m at 2e16 FLOPs and then n16.6m at 4e16 FLOPs only if the preceding extension also misses.
The selected candidate must retain n_latents=16 and d_bottleneck=16 and later pass a joint tokenizer-plus-medium-dynamics one-step A10 smoke before dynamics training is authorized.
Metric eligibility is provisional: dynamics remains blocked until the aligned reconstruction grid receives explicit visual acceptance for player outline and platform-edge clarity.
